question: MS Subbulakshmi was a famous ______ singer of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnatic.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshm**i (16 September 1916 – 11 December 2004) was an Indian Carnatic singer from Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• She was **the first musician ever to be awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****
